end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used flat faces and curved faces to identify cylinders; candle was named as a cylinder.
Aditya identified balls as spheres and described a cricket ball as round.
Aditya continued to think a cone changes its name when turned upside down; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names using familiar objects and the clues “flat faces” and “curved face.” Aditya used these clues for cylinders and connected balls with spheres. The mix-up about a cone staying a cone when turned was still present at the end. At home, turn a cone-shaped object around and ask, “Did its shape name change?”
